about.title: Benicia Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Benicia recorded 3 traffic deaths alongside 89 injury collisions in the most recent final crash year, numbers that represent real families now facing sudden, permanent loss. Whether the crash happened on I-780, I-680, Lake Herman Road, or E 2nd Street, surviving spouses, domestic partners, and children may have the right to pursue a wrongful death claim under California law. These cases are separate from any criminal proceeding and focus on the financial and emotional toll left behind — funeral costs, lost income the person would have provided, and the loss of their guidance and companionship. LawProactive is not a law firm; we simply connect grieving families in Benicia with an independent personal injury attorney who can review the details of the crash, explain standing and deadlines, and help determine what steps make sense next. There is no fee unless the attorney recovers compensation on your behalf.

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to spouses, domestic partners, and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. An attorney can help clarify where your family fits before decisions are made.

items.title: Awareness of the Filing Deadline
items.desc: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, though claims against a government entity involving Benicia roadways may carry a much shorter window. Acting sooner preserves options.

items.title: Guidance on What Losses Count
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. An independent attorney can help document these losses accurately.

items.question: Who is allowed to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, a surviving spouse, domestic partner, or children have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may qualify under state law. An independent attorney can review your family's specific situation to confirm standing.

items.question: How long do we have to file after a fatal crash in Benicia?
items.answer: California typically allows two years from the date of death for a wrongful death claim, but if a government road or agency is involved — which can come up with corridors like Lake Herman Road or I-780 — the deadline is often much shorter. It's important to get guidance quickly rather than wait.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No, they are separate proceedings. A criminal case, if any, is brought by the state and focuses on punishment, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action focused on compensating the surviving family. You can pursue a civil claim regardless of what happens criminally.

items.question: What costs are involved in speaking with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: There is no cost to be connected with an independent attorney through LawProactive. Attorneys in the network generally work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover compensation for your family.
